scope: R18 span sweep: a one-parameter family interpolating geometrically between the equal-budget constant degree and the budget-calibrated radial rule, every member rescaled to the same per-call budget, propagated at both vector tolerance levels on both populations.
relationship_to_r14: additive. The two endpoints are not re-propagated: k=0 and k=1 are read from the frozen R14 beta=1 record, and the per-orbit Atallah tolerance, comparator degree and truth trajectories are reused unchanged. R18 adds only the interior of the path.
